name: Maryland MPSSAA State Cross Country Championships
headline: Maryland MPSSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: In 4A, Urbana edged Crofton 134 to 138 for the boys title and Walt Whitman won the girls title (74), with Walt Whitman’s Jonah Greszler (15:50.5) and Clarksburg’s Madeline Kelly (18:32.3) winning the races. In 3A, Centennial (boys, 109) and Severna Park (girls, 44) won, with individual titles to Sherwood’s Dimitrios Rementelas (15:53.1) and North Hagerstown’s Mackenzie Philp (18:24.4). Host Hereford swept 2A (boys 104, girls 31) as Eli Aitken won in 16:03.5 and C. Milton Wright’s Brielle Deaner won the girls race (19:07.9), while Smithsburg (boys, 54) and Liberty (girls, 36) won 1A behind winners Dylan Herbst (15:59.8) and Ava Snyder (19:45.9).
